name: Aio Momiji
source:
Momiji Aio is a second-year student, recognizable by her long pink hair and flamboyant wardrobe; aspiring to be a playwright and director. A short, friendly girl, Momiji is meek and easily intimidated by nature; on stage, a serious and capable actress. She is good friends with [url=/c1757]Mirai[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors]Wikipedia[/url].]
